subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures keep direct /avatar/{agentId} as a generic 404 with specific reasons surfaced only through authenticated metadata/UI, or should the direct avatar route expose statuses such as 413 or 400?
rationale: The unresolved behavior is an authenticated local workspace file-serving boundary where richer errors improve UX but may reveal file existence, size, or policy details.

options.title: Improve UI diagnostics only
options.body: Keep direct image fetches generic while using existing metadata reasons and Control UI surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

options.title: Expose endpoint errors
options.body: Return direct-route statuses such as 413 or 400 after explicit security review and redaction tests.

options.title: Fold into broader avatar contract
options.body: Defer this issue to the broader remote/local avatar policy work tracked by #41201 and close only once that contract covers local diagnostics too.

recommendation.title: Improve UI diagnostics only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetches generic while using existing metadata reasons and Control UI surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across avatar support, avatar safety hardening, and Gateway/Control UI file-serving boundaries.
